Mixed list: ordered list nested inside unordered list

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<ul><li>Item A<ol><li>Sub 1</li><li>Sub 2</li></ol></li><li>Item B</li></ul>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
```
